The so-called probabilistic method is often use in tackling many problems in dis- crete mathematics [3, 3–5]. When trying to prove that a structure with certain properties exists, such a method consists in constructing a convenient probability space of structures and then, in showing that the desired properties hold in this space with a non-zero probability.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let A and Σ be finite alphabets, and let A* and Σ* denote the free monoids of finite words over A and Σ, respectively. A pattern is a non-empty word p over an alphabet Δ of variables. A word w over an alphabet B avoids p if there is no factor of w of the form h(p), where h : Δ* → B* is a non-erasing morphism. The pattern p is said to be k-avoidable if there exists an infinite word over an alphabet of size k that avoids p.

Given a morphism g : Σ* → Σ* and a letter a ∈ Σ such that g(a) begins with a and |g^n(a)| → ∞, let g^ω(a) denote the unique infinite word that is the limit of g^n(a). For a morphism f : Σ* → A*, the infinite word f(g^ω(a)) is called an HD0L word. The pattern p is said to be k-HD0L-avoidable if there exist an alphabet Σ with |Σ| = k, morphisms f : Σ* → A* and g : Σ* → Σ*, and a letter a ∈ Σ generating an infinite iteration, such that f(g^ω(a)) avoids p.

Prove or disprove: every k-avoidable pattern is k-HD0L-avoidable.
artifact.status_search_result: The question whether every k-avoidable pattern is k-HD0L-avoidable is stated as an open conjecture in problem collections on combinatorics on words. While it is known that every avoidable pattern is D0L-avoidable (over some alphabet), refining this to match the avoidability index k via HD0L morphic words remains an open problem. No published resolution was found.

status_evidence.title: Avoidability of palindrome patterns (Ochem)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses avoidability indices and uses HD0L/morphic constructions to obtain avoiding infinite words over alphabets of small size.
status_evidence.claim: HD0L-avoidance via iterated morphisms is a standard technique, but matching the avoidability index k is conjectural.

status_evidence.title: Avoidability of formulas with two variables
status_evidence.snippet: Uses morphic words to demonstrate avoidability over alphabets of given sizes.
status_evidence.claim: The technique of using HD0L words is established but the general implication k-avoidable ⇒ k-HD0L-avoidable is not proved.
